lineItems.title: Advanced Imaging and Cancer Centre Equipment Procurement
lineItems.details: Equipping the Advanced Imaging and Cancer Centre with diagnostic, surgical, and radiation oncology systems alongside an 80-bed inpatient facility.

lineItems.title: Asphaltic Road Construction at Rafukka Axis
lineItems.details: Reconstruction of the Rafukka axis road using asphaltic wearing course to combat stormwater erosion and stabilize urban supply chains.

lineItems.title: Hybrid Bus Intra-City Fleet Operations & Maintenance Infrastructure
lineItems.details: Rollout and operational management of 30 hybrid shuttle buses, solar-inverter microgrids, transformer substations, and digital fleet monitoring.

lineItems.title: Statewide Transport Infrastructure & Road Development
lineItems.details: Priority capital investment in state road construction, civil works, and public mobility infrastructure across Cross River State.

lineItems.title: Universal Basic Education & School Facilities Upgrade
lineItems.details: Free primary to junior secondary education support, classroom construction, WAEC examination fee coverage, and vocational training expansion.

lineItems.title: Healthcare Facilities & Nursing School Accreditation Upgrades
lineItems.details: Upgrading state-owned Schools of Nursing and Midwifery, expanding immunisation coverage, and funding secondary health facilities.

lineItems.title: Aviation Fleet Integration & Regional Airport Expansion
lineItems.details: Integration of a fifth Bombardier CRJ jet into state aviation assets and accelerated construction of Obudu International Passenger and Cargo Airport.

lineItems.title: Electric Vehicle Fleet Acquisition & Green Public Transit
lineItems.details: Procurement of 730 electric vehicles, including metropolitan buses, tricycles, and motorcycles for clean public transportation.
